notable_quotes: In MAC-4-OH, μ3-OH groups form hydrogen bonds with CO2 oxygen atoms, providing a mechanistic basis for stronger CO2 binding.
CO2 also interacts with the OH-IPA ligand in MAC-4-OH; the C···O distance is about 3.35 Å, consistent with electrostatic attraction.
Activated MAC-4-OH shows measurable high-pressure CO2 uptake at 298 K, indicating CO2 adsorption capacity in the desolvated framework.
